title: Locally constant functions factor through a cofiltered profinite stage
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $J$ be a small cofiltered category, let $F:J\to\mathbf{Prof}$ be a diagram of compact Hausdorff totally disconnected spaces and continuous maps, and let $(S,(p_j:S\to F(j))_j)$ be a limiting cone in that category. For every set $A$ and every locally constant function $h:S\to A$ (each point has an open neighbourhood on which $h$ is constant), there exist $j\in J$ and a locally constant $h_j:F(j)\to A$ with $h=h_j\circ p_j$. No nonemptiness assumption on $S$ or $A$ is imposed.
